business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides private higher vocational education services in Mainland China, mainly through tuition and boarding fees received in advance.

segments.business_substance: Tuition and boarding fees from higher education services in Mainland China.

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally received before the beginning of each academic year and recognised over the service period.
business_notes: PRC operating schools and school sponsors contributed 100% of revenue, 132% of net profit and 96% of total assets for FY2023.
Provision of higher education in the PRC is a restricted foreign investment category; the issuer uses structured contracts for consolidation.

non_recurring_items.item: Exchange loss arising from USD syndicated loans
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Management's adjusted net profit adds back this debt-related FX loss.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report management discussion and analysis, pp.31-34

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and bank balances before deducting pledged/restricted deposits and time deposits classification.
Unrestricted cash-equivalent balance in consolidated cash flow presentation, but mostly RMB/PRC operating structure.
funds_assets.source: Annual report statement of financial position and note 22, pp.121,188

funds_assets.item: Pledged deposits for bank loans and other loans
funds_assets.business_substance: Deposit pledged to secure bank and other borrowings; treated as debt-offset asset rather than freely detachable cash.
funds_assets.source: Annual report note 22 and note 25, pp.188,191

funds_assets.business_substance: Project deposit, restricted for ordinary detachable cash purposes.

funds_assets.business_substance: Mainland bank wealth investment products and foreign exchange options.

operating_assets.source: Annual report statement of financial position, p.121

Annual report statement of financial position, p.121

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured bank and other borrowings, including current and non-current portions.
Office lease liabilities; small and reflected in continuing operating economics.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Tuition and boarding fees received in advance from students for services not yet provided; students have refund rights for unprovided service portion.
Includes PPE payables, dividends payable, student miscellaneous fees, government subsidies payable, payroll accruals and deposits.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual report statement of financial position and note 24, pp.121,188-189

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred income, mainly government grants related to PPE.

Statement of cash flows and financial summary, pp.125,220-221

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow has been above parent net profit in recent years because tuition and boarding fees are collected in advance; however, the business requires recurring school construction, facilities and software capex, with FY2023 capital expenditure disclosed at RMB745.7 million.

evidence.source: Annual report consolidated statement of profit or loss and note 6, pp.119,163-164
Annual report statement of financial position and note 22, pp.121,188

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries and VIE schools.
The annual report does not provide a precise maintenance versus growth capex split.
Only the requested annual fact pack was written to stock_report; older annual reports were not separately downloaded into stock_report target paths.
